verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents MFA as a way to add extra layers of security to an app (appwrite-docs-4), and it supports 30+ social OAuth providers such as GitHub, Google and Apple (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-45). Nothing in the pack shows enterprise SSO via SAML or generic OIDC, or a way for an admin to require MFA rather than just offer it. Missing for 10: SAML enterprise SSO, generic OIDC/enterprise IdP federation, admin-enforced (required) MFA policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
